profile.name: Interson USB多普勒超声探头
profile.description: 这是一类通过 USB 连接的超声探头，可进行常规超声成像，并支持多普勒相关采集，用于实验室或教学中的结构观察、流动现象监测和动态图像记录。根据具体探头结构，设备也可能包含用于机械扫描的内部电机。
profile.description_en: This is a USB-connected ultrasound probe that performs standard ultrasound imaging and supports Doppler-related acquisition. It is used in laboratories or teaching environments for structural observation, flow-related measurements, and dynamic image recording. Depending on the probe design, the device may also include an internal motor for mechanical scanning.

registry.name: Doppler Ultrasound
registry.description: Doppler Ultrasound Device是一款超声破碎仪，主要功能包括停止、初始化、启动、成像、数据保存、读取数据。支持BulkIn, BulkOut, BulkOutFour等操作。
